'''Brian Cano''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 83 from Staten Island, Ny. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He started playing in 1995 and was a tournament director before joining the squadron. He ran Young Jedi demos at Star Wars Celebration in Denver (1999) and attended DecipherCon in Virginia Beach.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
In the starter deck I got Han Solo, and in the booster pack I got Darth Vader. WOW. What a start. And the rest as they say, is history. Player, tournament director, Squadron member....complete the progression please. =)

So, whenever you find yourself in the Coruscant Region, feel free to give me a shout. Oh, and don't forget your umbrella! =)<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
